chapter: Part Two: theaters and the Chicago scene
title: What happened to theater bands after sound came in
summary: They turned to ballrooms and nightclubs.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, what happened to those bands when sound came into movies?
You don't hear much of Tate or Payton after 1930, you know, of activity. But I'm sure they must have been doing things?

Yeah, well, I know Tate was. Tate still had his dance orchestra. Of course, I wasn't with him then, but he played for a lot of arrangers -- you know, dances and things at the different ballrooms, you know.
